comparison.objective: Unscrew a jar, load a block, and screw it closed; candidate finishes installed inserts by breaking and recovering their tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Jar task tests threaded lid manipulation and object placement; candidate tests small coaxial tool alignment, bimanual hammering, force regulation, and fragment search.
comparison.success_condition: Jar must contain the block and be reclosed. Setup and scoring details are missing; candidate requires four safe fractures and physical containment of every released tang without insert or shell damage.
comparison.reason: Threaded container opening and closure does not test contact-driven notch fracture or loose metal-fragment recovery.
